name: Brown Rice Peas Pulao
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ⅓ cup brown rice, rinsed and soaked 30 minutes
1 bay leaf, 2 cloves, 2 cardamom pods and ½ tsp cumin seeds
1 extra cup non-starchy vegetables (spinach, cabbage or green beans), chopped
steps: Heat the oil and crackle the whole spices. Add the onion and cook for 4 minutes until golden.
Add the extra chopped vegetables together with the other vegetables.
Add the ginger-garlic paste, chilli and peas and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the drained rice, water and salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low for 25 minutes, or pressure-cook for 3 whistles.
Rest 5 minutes, fluff and add coriander.
note: Brown rice keeps its bran, which means more fibre and slower digestion.
